title: Recipe
no_type: The recipe has no "type" yet: pick one in the menu above
type_change.title: Change the type to «%s»?
type_change.convert: Ingredients and the result carry over where the new type has room for them. Fields it does not have are removed, and values it reads differently may break. Ctrl+Z in the text undoes the change.
type_change.keep: Only "type" changes: the other fields stay as they are, and the new type may not read them or read them differently. Ctrl+Z in the text undoes the change.
shaped.too_large: The pattern is larger than 3×3; edit it as text
palette.pick_slot: Click a slot, then an item or a tag, or drag one onto a slot. Right click clears a slot.
palette.shift_hint: Shift+click adds the item as one more alternative. The slot's details are in the Inspector.
inspector.empty: The slot is empty: click an item in the palette or drag one onto the slot.
inspector.alternatives_hint: Any of these fits. Shift+click in the palette adds one more.
inspector.strict_hint: The stack must have exactly these components and no others
inspector.custom_hint: This ingredient type has no editor; change it in the text.
